If failed, it cannot benefit from the Shock Special Rule and suffers -2 to Impact Hits until the end of the Round. Veil of Doubt (Clash): Until the end of this Round, when an Enemy Regiment declares a Clash Action against this Regiment, it must perform a Resolve Characteristic Test.
